overview: This paper proposes Masked Group-Sparse Autoencoders (MGSAE) for decomposing multimodal embedding spaces (e.g., CLIP, CLAP) into sparse dictionaries with improved cross-modal alignment, using group-sparse regularization on paired samples and cross-modal random masking to overcome the split-dictionary phenomenon of standard SAEs, evaluated via multimodal monosemanticity scores, zero-shot cross-modal tasks, and interpretability analyses.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Centralized management of all experiment configurations including model variant selection (SAE/GSAE/MGSAE), encoder type (CLIP/CLAP/SIGLIP2/AIMv2), dataset selection, sparsity level, expansion factor, group-sparsity regularization weight, mask probability, training hyperparameters, and evaluation settings, with support for configuration inheritance and reproducibility.

modules.name: Paired Multimodal Embedding Loader
modules.description: Custom dataset and dataloader for loading pre-extracted paired multimodal embeddings (image/text or audio/text pairs) from datasets such as CC3M, MS COCO, and JamendoMaxCaps, handling modality balancing within batches, unit-norm normalization of embeddings, and ensuring paired samples are collated together for group-sparse training.

modules.name: TopK Sparse Autoencoder Base Architecture
modules.description: Implementation of the standard TopK SAE model with encoder matrix, decoder dictionary matrix, pre-coding bias, encoder bias, and TopK projection function that retains only the K largest activations while zeroing the rest, supporting the forward pass of encoding, sparsification, and reconstruction.

modules.name: Group-Sparse Loss Module
modules.description: Implementation of the L2,1 group-norm loss that computes the sum over coordinates of the square root of paired squared activations, encouraging joint sparsity structure between the sparse codes of semantically paired samples from different modalities so that shared concepts activate the same dictionary elements.

modules.name: Cross-Modal Random Masking
modules.description: Implementation of the shared random mask mechanism applied prior to the TopK operation during training, where the same binary mask sampled with a given probability is applied to the pre-TopK latent vectors of both modalities in a paired sample, forcing the TopK selection to operate on the same coordinate subset and promoting multimodal neuron usage while reducing dead neurons.

modules.name: GSAE Training Pipeline
modules.description: Training loop for the Group-Sparse Autoencoder variant that combines reconstruction loss for both modalities with the group-sparse regularization term weighted by a hyperparameter, handling paired forward passes through a shared encoder and decoder, and parameter updates via Adam optimizer without the random masking component.

modules.name: MGSAE Training Pipeline
modules.description: Full training loop for the Masked Group-Sparse Autoencoder integrating both the group-sparse loss and cross-modal random masking, including epoch management, gradient computation with the combined objective, convergence monitoring via fraction of explained variance per modality, and learning rate scheduling based on expansion factor scaling laws.

modules.name: Multimodal Monosemanticity Score (MMS)
modules.description: Implementation of the proposed MMS metric that quantifies semantic coherence and cross-modal alignment of each SAE neuron by computing a weighted average of cosine similarities between co-activating inputs from any two modalities, using a separate reference encoder for similarity computation, with normalization of co-activation weights and support for both intra-modal and cross-modal modality pairs.

modules.name: Dead Neuron and Modality Activation Analyzer
modules.description: Module for counting and categorizing SAE neurons based on their activation patterns across modalities on validation data, classifying each neuron as activating for image-only, text-only, both modalities, or neither (dead), enabling comparison of multimodal concept learning across SAE variants.

modules.name: Zero-Shot Cross-Modal Task Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluation framework for measuring modality alignment preservation in sparse codes via zero-shot tasks, including image classification on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet using CLIP sparse text embeddings as classifiers, audio classification on GTZAN and NSynth, and text-to-audio retrieval on FMACaps measured by mean reciprocal rank, serving as a proxy for cross-modal alignment quality.

modules.name: Concept Naming Module
modules.description: Implementation of the Discover-then-Name approach for assigning interpretable labels to dictionary vectors by computing cosine similarity between each normalized dictionary element and text embeddings from a large vocabulary corpus (frequent unigrams and bigrams), selecting the highest-similarity word or phrase as the concept name for each dictionary direction.

modules.name: Linear Probe Interpretation Module
modules.description: Module for interpreting trained linear classifiers by decomposing their weight vectors in the learned dictionary basis, computing the projection of the classifier parameter onto each normalized dictionary vector to identify which learned concepts contribute most to the classification decision, enabling detection of spurious correlations and semantic feature attribution.

modules.name: Latent Steering and Intervention Module
modules.description: Implementation of cross-modal steering by encoding a text prompt to a sparse code, intervening on specific concept neurons by adding controlled activation values, decoding back to dense space, and performing downstream tasks such as retrieval, demonstrating how multimodal dictionary alignment enables controllable manipulation of cross-modal outputs.

modules.name: Ablation and Hyperparameter Sensitivity Framework
modules.description: Systematic framework for controlled ablation studies comparing SAE, GSAE, and MGSAE variants, and for sweeping key hyperparameters including expansion factor, sparsity level K, group-sparsity regularization weight lambda, and mask probability p, with automated selection heuristics based on explained variance and average sparsity constraints, and reporting zero-shot performance and neuron statistics for each configuration.

modules.name: Logging, Checkpointing, and Result Aggregation
modules.description: Infrastructure for training progress logging with per-modality reconstruction loss and group-sparse loss tracking, model checkpoint saving and loading, experiment tracking integration, and automated generation of comparison tables and figures including MMS score plots, dead neuron bar charts, zero-shot performance tables across datasets and model variants, and concept naming result visualizations.
